title: [Enhancement] Hard Reset Transmitter as a button in G5/G6 debug settings- not requiring engineering mode
body:
I think it would be helpful to add the hard reset to the G5/G6 Debug Settings menu, with a confirmation of action. 

I don’t really understand the rationale for enabling engineering mode to do it either?

comments.body:
@tim2000s There is no need to enable engineering mode to hard reset a transmitter.
Do you still believe a hard reset button should be placed on the G5/G6 Debug Settings page?
Why?
What if someone likes to have a "Clear TX Queue" on that page?
Where do we draw the line?
